_note: v2 hook overrides for l'Allée des Reflets (ST_reflets, S16_park). Every hook describes what is actually painted (nothing is written in the paintings): Monsieur Verbe the striped mime acts out each verb; the hand mirror marks the one reflexive verb (s'avérer); armer and empoisonner are shown only as blank plaques.

fr_temoigner_verb.hook: At the witness stand Monsieur Verbe raises his right hand to TESTIFY, holding up his evidence: a TAME ONION (tay-mwah-NYAY).
fr_temoigner_verb.why: TAME ONION → témoigner = to testify, bear witness (elle témoigne au procès). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_demontrer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe spins the little toy windmill on the table to DEMONSTRATE how it works (day-mohn-TRAY).
fr_demontrer_verb.why: Demonstrate → démontrer = to prove, to demonstrate (il a démontré que la théorie était fausse). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_guetter_verb.hook: Crouching by the cat, Monsieur Verbe WATCHES FOR the mouse at its hole in the stone mound: they want to GET it (gay-TAY).
fr_guetter_verb.why: GET it → guetter = to watch for, lie in wait for (le chat guette la souris). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_figurer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe steps into the empty gilded frame and poses: he is the FIGURE in the picture (fee-gew-RAY).
fr_figurer_verb.why: Figure → figurer = to appear, to be included (son nom figure sur la liste). Se figurer = to imagine; the card teaches plain figurer, so no mirror. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_manifester_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe jumps for joy with his smiley placard: he MANIFESTS his joy for all to see (mah-nee-fehs-TAY).
fr_manifester_verb.why: Manifest → manifester = to show, express (il manifeste sa joie); also to demonstrate, protest. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_capter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe twiddles the knob of the old radio until its antenna CAPTURES the signal (kahp-TAY).
fr_capter_verb.why: Capture → capter = to pick up (a signal), to detect (ici, la radio capte mal). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_capturer_verb.hook: With one sweep of his net Monsieur Verbe CAPTURES a rare blue butterfly (kahp-tew-RAY).
fr_capturer_verb.why: Capture → capturer = to capture (ils ont capturé un papillon rare). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_surgir_verb.hook: An orange cat SURGES out of the laundry basket and Monsieur Verbe leaps back: it APPEARED out of nowhere (sewr-ZHEER).
fr_surgir_verb.why: SURGE → surgir = to appear suddenly, spring up (un chat surgit de derrière la porte). GREEN beret = regular -ir (nous surgissons).

fr_soupconner_verb.hook: Magnifying glass in hand, Monsieur Verbe studies the black cat beside the bowl of SOUP: he SUSPECTS it has its eye on his lunch (soop-soh-NAY).
fr_soupconner_verb.why: SOUP → soupçonner = to suspect (je soupçonne le chat d'avoir mangé le poisson). RED beret = regular -er. (nous soupçonnons: the ç keeps the soft s).

fr_scier_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SAWS a plank on the trestles: SEE-AY, SEE-AY goes the saw (SYAY).
fr_scier_verb.why: SAW → scier = to saw (il scie une planche). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_feindre_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe swoons on the bench, back of his hand to his forehead: he FEIGNS a FAINT, but his tongue is out (FANDR).
fr_feindre_verb.why: FEIGN, FAINT → feindre = to feign, pretend (il feint de ne pas m'entendre). GOLD beret = irregular (je feins, nous feignons).

fr_alerter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe rings the brass bell to ALERT everyone, and the startled duck flaps away (ah-lehr-TAY).
fr_alerter_verb.why: Alert → alerter = to alert, warn (les voisins ont alerté les pompiers). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_bercer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe gently ROCKS the cradle where the teddy BEAR is sleeping (behr-SAY).
fr_bercer_verb.why: BEAR in the cradle → bercer = to rock, to cradle (la maman berce son bébé); un berceau = a cradle. RED beret = regular -er. (nous berçons).

fr_embeter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe keeps pestering the grumpy goat; the BEAST (une bête) is very ANNOYED (ahn-bay-TAY).
fr_embeter_verb.why: Bête (beast) → embêter = to annoy, bother (arrête d'embêter ta sœur !). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_averer_verb.hook: Holding his hand mirror, Monsieur Verbe lifts the lid of the old chest: it TURNS OUT to hold a golden crown, a VERY nice surprise (sah-vay-RAY).
fr_averer_verb.why: VERY → s'avérer = to turn out, prove (to be) (le voyage s'est avéré très agréable). The hand mirror shows it is reflexive: il S'EST avéré. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_armer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the guide points to the blank plaque on the signboard: armer, to equip, as when you fit out (ARM) a ship for a long voyage (ahr-MAY).
fr_armer_verb.why: Shown only as a plaque, nothing drawn; ARM → armer = to arm, to equip. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_eveiller_verb.hook: The rooster crows and Monsieur Verbe yawns AWAKE in his hammock between the apple trees (ay-vay-YAY).
fr_eveiller_verb.why: AWAKE → éveiller = to awaken, arouse (ce livre éveille la curiosité des enfants). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_stimuler_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe cranks the jack-in-the-box and the clown springs up: very STIMULATING! (stee-mew-LAY)
fr_stimuler_verb.why: Stimulate → stimuler = to stimulate, to whip up (le café stimule l'esprit). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_espionner_verb.hook: Peeping over the hedge, Monsieur Verbe SPIES through his binoculars (ehs-pyoh-NAY).
fr_espionner_verb.why: ESPIONAGE, spy → espionner = to spy on (le petit frère espionne sa sœur). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_percevoir_verb.hook: Hand cupped to his ear, Monsieur Verbe PERCEIVES a strange sound, his PURSE waiting on the tree stump (pehr-suh-VWAHR).
fr_percevoir_verb.why: PURSE → percevoir = to perceive, make out (il perçoit un bruit étrange); also to collect money. GOLD beret = irregular (je perçois, nous percevons).

fr_vibrer_verb.hook: The phone in Monsieur Verbe's hand VIBRATES, buzz buzz (vee-BRAY).
fr_vibrer_verb.why: Vibrate → vibrer = to vibrate (mon téléphone vibre dans ma poche). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_irriter_verb.hook: A buzzing fly at his EAR IRRITATES Monsieur Verbe, and he scowls (ee-ree-TAY).
fr_irriter_verb.why: EAR, irritate → irriter = to irritate, annoy; also to make sore. Example replaced (the vocab example was about smoke stinging the eyes). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_cerner_verb.hook: A gaggle of geese SURROUNDS Monsieur Verbe: he is CORNERED (sehr-NAY).
fr_cerner_verb.why: CORNER → cerner = to surround; also to figure out (je n'arrive pas à cerner le problème). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_semer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe SOWS SEEDS from his basket as the sparrows hop after them (suh-MAY).
fr_semer_verb.why: SEEDS (une semence) → semer = to sow (le jardinier sème des carottes); also to shake off a pursuer. RED beret = regular -er. (je sème, nous semons).

fr_parer_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe ADORNS himself with a flower garland to impress the PARROT (pah-RAY).
fr_parer_verb.why: PARROT → parer = to adorn, deck out; also to ward off (parer un coup). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_aveugler_verb.hook: The headlights of the little cream car BLIND Monsieur Verbe and he screws up his eyes behind his arm (ah-vuh-GLAY).
fr_aveugler_verb.why: Aveugle (blind) → aveugler = to blind, dazzle (les phares de la voiture m'aveuglent). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_empoisonner_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe the guide points to the blank plaque on the stone wall: empoisonner, the fairy-tale word for the wicked queen's apple (ahn-pwah-zoh-NAY).
fr_empoisonner_verb.why: Shown only as a plaque, nothing drawn; POISON → empoisonner = to poison; in everyday speech also to pester. RED beret = regular -er.

fr_bruire_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe listens close to the tree: its leaves RUSTLE in the BREEZE (brew-EER).
fr_bruire_verb.why: BREEZE → bruire = to rustle, murmur (le bruit = the noise). GOLD beret = irregular and defective: mostly il bruit, ils bruissent.

fr_degouter_verb.hook: Monsieur Verbe pulls a face, tongue out, at the bowl of spinach: he has no TASTE (goût) for it (day-goo-TAY).
fr_degouter_verb.why: Dé- + goût (taste) → dégoûter = to disgust, put off (les épinards me dégoûtent). RED beret = regular -er.

fr_refleter_verb.hook: Kneeling at the still lake, Monsieur Verbe sees his own REFLECTION in the water (ruh-flay-TAY).
fr_refleter_verb.why: Reflect → refléter = to reflect (le lac reflète les montagnes). The lake does the reflecting, so no hand mirror: not reflexive. RED beret = regular -er. (je reflète, nous reflétons).
